dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete expert details not in a generic model: default egress filter recommendation, weight‑sum rule, mTLS via SDS, circuit‑breaking thresholds, recent 2024‑2026 feature notes, and a decision tree for weighted routing. However much of the content restates official docs, so full 20 is not earned.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific procedures: ordered pre‑flight IAM/CloudMap/ACM checks, exact CLI creation order (mesh → nodes → router → route → gateway), mandatory CONFIRM gate, snapshot before route updates, and side‑car injection steps. Only minor generic phrasing (e.g., "verify permissions") prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Provides a detailed NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., never use ALLOW_ALL in production, never mix CLI and CRD for gateway routes, never treat virtual nodes as workloads). Lacks a few additional pitfalls (e.g., forgetting to set health checks) and some reasons could be deeper, so deduct two points.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Complete frontmatter, clear description, explicit when‑to‑use, activation triggers, invocation schema, and verdict shape. An agent can reliably decide when to invoke the skill.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered: quick reference first, then mindset, pre‑flight, process, patterns, and output format. The only issue is occasional dense tables that could overload a first read.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are tightly constrained by a CONFIRM gate and exhaustive pre‑flight checks; creative spec refinement is allowed with minimal constraints. Calibration matches task fragility perfectly.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable skill pattern (What it does, Mindset, Quick navigation, Process, Common patterns, Output contract) that aids comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides working CLI command templates, decision trees, error handling via PREREQUISITES_MISSING, and concrete examples. Deductions for placeholder tokens like '<full spec>' in some examples and limited discussion of CLI failure handling.
